entries.claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC + REDUCED-MODE theorem computes the fixed-representative sphere-integrated axial Einstein Lee-Wald slice density for all integer ell>=2 and real omega!=0 and proves its exact nonvanishing. It does not classify the additional branch, construct an asymptotic phase space or Hilbert norm, define a scattering flux topology, or establish a polar, stability, particle, positivity or quantum result.

dispersion.statement: The imported exact Einstein branches have rates 0 and -2 i omega; the literal current theorem uses their certified all-orders formal recurrences.

lee_wald.statement: For both axial Einstein branches, F^v(E,bar E)=A_EE r^-2+O(r^-3) with explicit nonzero A_EE for every integer ell>=2 and real omega!=0. This is a fixed-representative finite radial form, not a Hilbert norm or scattering topology.

resonance.statement: The legacy E2 basis denominator has no real-frequency zero on the discrete physical angular domain; the unit-F normalization contains no such wall.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: No nonlinear or second-order solution is evaluated.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded propagator or causal phase space is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No compact second-order Taub map is involved.
